Frequently Asked Questions — Colored Window Film in Arizona

Will colored window film fade over time in Arizona sun?

Quality Solyx colored films use UV-stable dye systems engineered for high-UV climates. Expect minimal color shift over a 10-year period on interior applications.

Can I mix colored films with clear film on the same window?

Yes — zone application is a common technique. Colored film on lower sections, clear on upper sections, with or without a gradient transition.

Does colored film affect the amount of light coming in?

Translucent colored films reduce light transmission by 30–70% depending on color density. Transparent colored films maintain higher light levels with a color overlay.

How much does colored window film cost in Phoenix?

Colored film installation typically runs $9–$18 per square foot. Specialty dichroic films are priced higher. Call (480) 788-1591 for a site-specific quote.
